'''Gustáv Murín''' (born 9 April 1959) is a [[Slovak people|Slovak]] author and journalist. He has written critically on corruption in [[Politics of Slovakia|Slovak politics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aktuality.sk/clanok/183475/gustav-murin-o-mafii-jej-politickom-kryti-aj-spisiakovi/|title=Gustáv Murín o mafii, jej politickom krytí aj Spišiakovi|website=Aktuality.sk}}</ref> His ''Small World'' was published in France as ''Le monde est petit''. He was president of the PEN centre of Slovakia 2000 – 2004, 2009 – 2011.<ref>International Who's Who of Authors and Writers 2004 – Page 615
Europa Publications – 2003 Website: www.scpen.sk. Pres.: Gustav Murin. Slovene PEN Centre: ..</ref><ref>The Southern California Anthology – Page 131
Jonathan R. Woetzel – 2006    Gustav Murin, a native of Slovakia, is the author of the novel How Are You; the novella The Case of a Buried ...</ref><ref>Kosmas: Czechoslovak and Central European Journal

==Biography==
Gustáv Murín was born on 9 April 1959 in the [[Rača, Bratislava|Rača]] borough of [[Bratislava]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Moravčík |first1=Marek |title=Starosta Rače Drotován: Gustáv Murín je pre mňa stále Račan, aj keď s ním nesúhlasím |url=https://bratislava.sme.sk/c/23446444/starosta-race-drotovan-gustav-murin-je-pre-mna-stale-racan-aj-ked-s-nim-nesuhlasim.html |website=bratislava.sme.sk |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref> His father was a university professor. Murín studied biology at the [[Comenius University]], graduating in 1984<ref>{{cite web |title=Gustáv Murín - Životopis autora |url=https://www.litcentrum.sk/autor/gustav-murin/zivotopis-autora |website=Slovenské literárne centrum |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref>

Murín became active as a writer in the 1980s, contributing to literary magazines including [[Slovenské pohľady]] and ''Romboid''. In the 1990s, while working as an assistant professor of biology at the Comenius University, Murín established an [[almanac]] of regional literature ''Central Europe – Now''. In 1994 he was briefly an editor of the Slovak edition of the [[Playboy]] magazine. He also organized meetings of young writers in [[Budmerice]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Jubilant GUSTÁV MURÍN :: SPOLOK SLOVENSKÝCH SPISOVATEĽOV |url=https://www.spolok-slovenskych-spisovatelov.sk/news/jubilant-gustav-murin/ |website=www.spolok-slovenskych-spisovatelov.sk |access-date=22 May 2025}}</ref>

Since the early 2000s years, Murín has published a large number of books, typically compilations of newspaper articles dealing with the history of mafia in Slovakia.<ref name = "sme">{{cite web |last1=Moravčík |first1=Marek |title=Literárnemu centru bude šéfovať konšpirátor, ktorý má spory so ženami |url=https://domov.sme.sk/c/23433417/literarnemu-centru-bude-sefovat-konspirator-ktory-ma-spory-so-zenami.html |website=domov.sme.sk |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref> While his books generally sold well, Murín has been accused by journalists in Slovakia of spreading conspiracy theories and pro-Russian fake news online and through his books. Murín was also as a blogger, spreading conspiracy narratives, including that the [[Boston Marathon bombing]] was a [[hoax]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Marec |first1=Samuel |title=Ja sa za to Slovensko tak strašne hanbím (píše Samo Marec) |url=https://komentare.sme.sk/c/23495736/ja-sa-za-to-slovensko-tak-strasne-hanbim-pise-samo-marec.html |website=komentare.sme.sk |access-date=25 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref>

In 2018, he shortly hosted a show about science on [[Radio and Television of Slovakia]], but was soon replaced after public backlash.<ref name="den n">{{cite web |last1=Struhárik |first1=Filip |title=Gustáv Murín ide do RTVS, bude jedným z autorov relácií o vede a zahraničí |url=https://dennikn.sk/1084566/gustav-murin-ide-do-rtvs-bude-jednym-z-autorov-relacii-o-vede-a-zahranici/ |website=Denník N |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk-SK |date=4 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gustáv Murín v RTVS končí, oznámil Rezník |url=https://strategie.hnonline.sk/news/media/1738941-gustav-murin-v-rtvs-konci-oznamil-reznik |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk-sk |date=3 May 2018}}</ref> Later that year, the [[Comenius University]] fired Murín from his faculty position after the writer harassed and threatened a journalism student.<ref name="sme" />

In January 2025, Murín was appointed acting director of the Slovak Literary Centre by the culture minister [[Martina Šimkovičová]]. His appointment was met with resistance from the staff of the centre, who accused Murín of authoritarian management style as well as promoting ideas "at odds with democratic values".<ref>{{cite web |title=Literárne organizácie reagujú na Murínovo vymenovanie: Jeho svetonázor je v rozpore s demokratickými princípmi členského štátu Európskej únie |url=https://kultura.pravda.sk/na-citanie/clanok/736771-literarne-organizacie-reaguju-na-vymenovanie-murina-jeho-svetonazor-je-v-rozpore-s-demokratickymi-principmi-clenskeho-statu-euro/ |website=Pravda.sk |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk-SK |date=9 January 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Dudoň |first1=Michal |title=Riaditeľ sa zaoberá sebaprezentáciou a uplatňovaním moci. Zamestnanci literárneho centra tvrdia, že čelia autokracii |url=https://kultura.sme.sk/c/23445323/ostavame-chceme-odchod-murina-zamestnanci-literarneho-centra-sa-obavaju-rozkladu-institucie.html |website=kultura.sme.sk |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref> In May 2025, Murín participated at the ''World of Books'' exhibition of books in [[Prague]], where he caused controversy by defending the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], arguing that [[feminism]] was a form of totalitarianism akin to [[communism]] and [[Nazism]] and referring to former Czechoslovak  president [[Václav Havel]] as a "pawn of superpowers". Following the subsequent outcry from Czech and Slovak cultural circles, minister Šimkovičová removed Murín from office.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pastorek |first1=Miro |title=Murín skončil na čele literárneho centra / Po jeho konci volali podriadení aj spisovatelia. Osudným sa mu stal škandál v Prahe |url=https://www.postoj.sk/175732/feminizmus-je-totalitna-ideologia-a-havel-babka-inych-mocnosti-vyhlasil-sef-literarneho-centra |website=www.postoj.sk |access-date=22 May 2025 |language=sk}}</ref>

* 1990 ''Návraty zo svetla''
* 1998 ''Ako sa máš''
* 1998 ''Zvieratá, ja a iné'' 
* 2005 ''Svet je malý'' / ''Le monde est petit''  
* 2010 ''Návrat do budúcnosti''
* 2015 ''Volajú ma Žaluď – …a ešte ma nedostali''
